title: AMNESIA THE BUNKER Gameplay Walkthrough FULL GAME
confidence_note: principles at game level, not frame-accurate timestamps

observations.observation: The generator is the core loop: power = light = safety; fuel is a scarce resource; leaving the light is a risk/reward decision.
A single stalker that responds to light and sound; the player hears it before seeing it. Anticipation is the mechanic.
Light is a gameplay resource, not decoration — the whole tension system hangs on it.
One small interconnected facility, few rooms but each dense with purpose — quality of a small space over breadth.
